Public saunas in Minneapolis, MN

Minneapolis has one of the deepest public-sauna scenes in the US: hosted wood-fired saunas parked beside city lakes, a classic communal bathhouse, and several newer sauna-and-cold-plunge clubs. Several lake saunas are seasonal or move between park permits, so always check the booking page before you go.

7 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-10-21. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

FoxFire Breathworks (Lake Nokomis & Bde Maka Ska)

Schedule / who
Mixed public sessions; 18+ for individual sign-ups (13+ with an adult). Fall hours: Wed (Nokomis only), Fri 4:30/6:00/7:30 PM; Sat-Sun 9:00 & 10:30 AM, 4:00/6:00/7:30 PM. Hours change seasonally.
